title: 私たちはデビューした

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With their debuts behind them, King Halo and friends enjoy a lively lunch. The conversation eventually turns to a recent magazine article calling them the "Golden Generation."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tensions rise as they dispute which of them will be the star of their generation. It looks like their competition has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo is soon after approached by Kawakami Princess, who has also read the recent article and become a fervent fan as a result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite being initially caught off guard, King Halo isn't content with just one die-hard fan. Her talents must be celebrated throughout the world!
